prompt: Which of these is TRUE about Kenya?

options.text: The Great Migration is a journey made by penguins across Kenya.
The wildebeest herds of the Great Migration swim across the ocean to reach Kenya.
The Great Migration brings huge herds of wildebeest through the Maasai Mara ecosystem.
The Great Migration takes place in the Sahara Desert in northern Kenya.

explanation: The Great Migration brings huge herds of wildebeest through the Maasai Mara ecosystem.
